faqA1: Pricing abhi decide nahi hui hai. Ye Phase 1 build ek demo hai — koi payment nahi maanga jata, aur yahan koi plan promise nahi kiya ja raha.
faqA2: End-to-end encryption aur seed-phrase recovery design ke core me hain. Is Phase 1 build me ye abhi kisi asli backend se jude nahi hain, isliye demo se asli confidential mail mat bhejo.
faqA3: Aliases plan ka hissa hain: asli address ko chhupane ke liye addresses add, manage aur delete kar sakoge. Alias management Phase 1 build me abhi nahi hai.
faqA4: Sign-up Account Centre se hota hai aur Phase 1 me invite-gated hai. Public sign-up abhi khula nahi hai.
faqQ3: Kya main aliases use kar sakta hu?
featureAliasesDesc: Asli address chhupane ke liye aliases add, manage aur delete karo.
featurePrivateDesc: Encrypted mail sirf aap aur aapka recipient padh sakte hain.
featureProtectedDesc: Confidential mail kisi ko bhi bhejo, chahe wo Dusrel Mail use na karta ho.
featureSeedDesc: Aapki seed phrase account wapas lati hai. Use surakshit rakho.
landingSubtitle: Dusrel Mail pehla Dusrel web app hai: saaf, private webmail — folders, aliases aur password-protected mail ke saath. Koi ads nahi, koi tracking nahi.

secureSubtitle: Rozmarra ki wo suraksha jo ek busy inbox ko safe rakhti hai.
settingsNote: Ye sirf mail ki settings hain. Password, two-factor authentication aur sessions jaisi account settings Account Centre me hongi.
